desc: Parse the input to construct the functional graph where each node $i$ has a directed edge to $A_i$, and identify the connected components (cycles with attached trees).
For each component, identify the cycle nodes and the trees rooted on these cycle nodes.

Implement a dynamic programming approach (or memoized recursion) to count the number of valid assignments for each tree component, where the state is defined by the value assigned to the root of the tree.
Combine the results from the trees attached to each cycle node, iterating through all possible value assignments for the cycle nodes to sum up the total valid sequences modulo 998244353.
Compute in-degrees and use Kahn's algorithm to peel off tree nodes (reverse graph edges from $A_i \to i$).
Identify cycle nodes (those remaining after Kahn's).
Compute DP for tree nodes: `dp[u][v]` = number of ways for subtree at $u$ given $x_u \le v$. Use prefix sums of children's DP results.

Compute DP for cycle nodes: Since all cycle nodes must have equal values $v$, the total ways for a cycle of length $L$ with value $v$ is $v^L \times \prod_{u \in cycle} (\text{ways for tree attached to } u \text{ given } x_u \le v)$.
Sum over all $v \in [1, M]$ and print result modulo 998244353.
